name: Cattle grazing by a ruinous building
dimensions: Dimensions taken from <u>Victoria & Albert Museum Department of Prints and Drawings and Department of Paintings, Accessions 1928. </u> London: HMSO, 1929
summary: A drawing of cattle grazing by a ruinous building which has been extended by a construction of posts and planks, with a distant view across farmed land; also two pencil sketches of Chinese figures.
